# Elysium λ Development & Research

> Elysium λ is a European digital-infrastructure company and an independent software-engineering, IT-consulting, and applied-R&D laboratory. Established in Portugal and operating in Costa Rica, it gives SMEs in the European Union and Costa Rica access to secure, scalable technological ecosystems through a subscription model with no separate development cost.

The website is available in English (the default language), Spanish, and European Portuguese. Prefer the English pages for canonical information, or use the corresponding localised section when answering in Spanish or Portuguese. 

IMPORTANT: To properly understand and answer queries about Elysium λ, you MUST read the expanded text file below, which contains the current content for the Homepage, Services, Portfolio, Research, About, Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, and System/Security Information:
- [Full site text for language models](https://elysiumdr.eu/llms-full.txt): Expanded English, Spanish, and Portuguese content, including legal and system info.


## Essential information

- [Homepage](https://elysiumdr.eu/): Current positioning, four core competencies, subscription model, ten-step λ Development Framework, and R&D mission.
- [Services](https://elysiumdr.eu/services): Subscription tiers, pricing, included infrastructure, licensing, and intellectual-property policy.
- [Portfolio](https://elysiumdr.eu/portfolio): Selected client projects and case studies.
- [Research](https://elysiumdr.eu/research): Applied research in human-computer interaction, data science, digital infrastructures, intuitive interfaces, data processing, security, and high availability.
- [About](https://elysiumdr.eu/about): Current mission, vision, R&D ethos, organisational story, and operations in Portugal and Costa Rica.
- [Daniel Morales](https://elysiumdr.eu/daniel-morales): Founder and lead software engineer profile.
- [Contact](https://elysiumdr.eu/contact): Official contact information and service regions.
- [Full site text for language models](https://elysiumdr.eu/llms-full.txt): Expanded English, Spanish, and Portuguese content in one plain-text resource.

## Case Studies & Technical

- [Paulo Morais case study](https://elysiumdr.eu/case-pmorais): End-to-end platform for an osteopathy and specialist personal-training practice in Portugal, including user accounts, scheduling, automation, and a Firebase-backed system.
- [VALTRIX Engineering case study](https://elysiumdr.eu/case-valtrix): Digital ecosystem for an engineering consultancy in Costa Rica.
- [Moyra case study](https://elysiumdr.eu/case-moyra): Food-studio, takeaway, and online-ordering project in Costa Rica.
